title: Native query probe reports no results
root_cause: The client connects to port 48124, but the ClickHouse service is published on host port 48123. The connection is refused and the later result-count failure is a consequence of the missing connection.

relevant_evidence.why: A connection refusal precedes the result-count failure.
The service is published on host port 48123.
The client uses port 48124 and reports a count failure on connection error.
